audit.why: Yorick 1-2, Skill through 3/4-5/6, Yi at first item, Yorick again at 2+ items. phases[].side and win[] agree row for row with the packet chart.
Level 4-5 Wuju/Meditate, level 6 Highlander, first on-hit item for you; level 6 Maiden and item scaling for him — this matches the chart flipping to you at first item and back at 2+.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns added: Dark Procession 20s at rank 1, Mourning Mist 12s, so the all-in window is dateable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers call the cage 'E (Dark Procession)' — focus.text, loading, breakdown.cooldowns/trading/wave/late, dosFull[0], dontsFull[1], report[3], report[5], report[9], report[10], spikes[0], wants.you[2] and wants.foe[0]. Content spikes[1] also calls his R 'Eulogy of the Damned'.
audit.why: Dark Procession is W — the destructible wall that cages. E is Mourning Mist, a thrown globule that reduces armour, damages, slows and MARKS you, and his summoned units gain move speed toward the marked target. The page merged two abilities into one and then told the player to track a 16s cooldown that belongs to neither (W is 20s, E is 12s). It also lost the entire armour-shred-and-ghoul-acceleration effect, which is why his swarm suddenly reaches you. His R is Eulogy of the Isles.
audit.corrected: W named as the wall with its 20s, E named as Mourning Mist with the armour shred, slow and ghoul-speed mark, R name corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal anywhere, and no mention that Last Rites is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Last Rites heals him on a 6s-down-to-4s cooldown and carries the autoReset flag, so his burst opens with the reset — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast — and the heal decides every extended trade.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds and the reset tell written into spikes[0].text and early.

edits.before: His E (Dark Procession) mist-cage — it's the only thing that locks Alpha Strike out and traps me with Maiden and the ghoul swarm; bait or wait it out before every all-in. His W wall trap chains off it to seal the escape.
edits.after: His W (Dark Procession) — the destructible wall that cages me in with Maiden and the swarm, 20s at rank 1. Mourning Mist (E) is the mark that shreds my armour, slows me and speeds every ghoul onto me; bait the wall before any all-in.

edits.before: Track his E (Dark Procession) mist-cage above all — it's a ~16s cooldown and it's the only thing that stops Alpha Strike from kiting him; if he whiffs or it's down, that's my entire all-in window. Also note when his Maiden R is up, since the ghoul swarm doubles his fight DPS.
edits.after: Track his W (Dark Procession) above all — 20s at rank 1, the wall that stops me kiting him; if he whiffs it, that is my entire all-in window. Mourning Mist (E) is 12s and marks me so every ghoul sprints at me. Note when Maiden is up too, since the swarm doubles his fight DPS.
Beat the wall with Alpha Strike

edits.before: Save Alpha Strike's untargetable blink for the moment he throws his E mist-cage — blinking through it denies the trap and resets my attack timer onto him.
edits.after: Save Alpha Strike for the moment Dark Procession (W) drops — ending up on his side of the wall rather than sealed off denies the trap and resets my attack timer onto him.
Don't all-in with his wall up

edits.before: If his E mist-cage is available and you haven't baited it, an all-in gets trapped and the swarm grinds you down; wait for it to be on cooldown.
edits.after: If Dark Procession (W) is available and you haven't baited it, an all-in gets walled in and the swarm grinds you down; wait out that 20 seconds.

edits.before: Trade only when his E mist-cage is down or already thrown: Alpha Strike in, one Wuju-empowered auto, walk. Back off entirely if his ghoul swarm and Maiden are up and E is available — that extended trade is his.
edits.after: Trade only when Dark Procession (W) is down or already placed: Alpha Strike in, one Wuju-empowered auto, walk. Back off entirely if his swarm and Maiden are up and the wall is available — that extended trade is his.

edits.before: Alpha Strike's untargetable blink is the whole matchup — it dodges his E mist-cage and the W wall follow-up. Highlander's slow-immunity ignores his E slow and dodges his ganks. Meditate sustains the ghoul chip; Wuju Style's true damage ignores his bruiser armor and shreds Maiden.
edits.after: Alpha Strike's untargetable blink is the whole matchup — time it on Mourning Mist (E) and the mark, slow and armour shred all miss him. Highlander's slow immunity ignores that slow outright. Meditate sustains ghoul chip, though any CC cancels the channel; Wuju Style's true damage ignores his armour and shreds Maiden.

edits.before: Yorick walls you with Dark Procession (E cage) and his Mist Walkers (ghouls) plus Last Rites (Q) heal and out-trade you levels 1-2. Alpha Strike can hop between ghouls but they wear you down; play for farm and don't get cornered by the W cage.
edits.after: Yorick walls you in with Dark Procession (W) while Mourning Mist (E) shreds your armour and speeds his Mist Walkers onto you, and Last Rites (Q) heals him through every trade. Alpha Strike hops between ghouls but they wear you down — play for farm and carry Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Eulogy of the Damned (R) summons Maiden, a huge sustained-damage minion that turns any trade into a 2v1. Around here it's skill-and-wave dependent — clear ghouls with Alpha Strike before committing.
edits.after: Eulogy of the Isles (R) summons the Maiden, a sustained-damage minion that turns any trade into a 2v1 — and it is 160s at rank 1. Around here it is wave-dependent: clear ghouls with Alpha Strike before committing.

edits.before: Yorick out-lanes you levels 1-2: Last Rites (Q) heals him through your Alpha Strike, his Mist Walkers chip you, and Dark Procession can cage you for a free trade, so farm carefully and respect the E wall.
edits.after: Yorick out-lanes you levels 1-2: Last Rites (Q) is an auto-attack reset that heals him through your trades, his Mist Walkers chip you, and Dark Procession (W) cages you for a free one, so farm carefully and respect that wall.

edits.before: Fight when his E cage (Dark Procession) is on cooldown
edits.after: Fight while Dark Procession (W) is on its 20s cooldown

edits.before: Cage you with Dark Procession (E) to lock the trade
edits.after: Cage you with Dark Procession (W) to lock the trade

notes: The page treated Dark Procession as E and folded Mourning Mist into it, so it tracked a cooldown belonging to neither ability and never mentioned the armour shred or the ghoul-acceleration mark. Both are now separated. I did NOT rewrite the repeated claim that Alpha Strike 'dodges the cage' into a mechanical assertion about blinking through a destructible wall — whether Alpha Strike crosses Dark Procession is not in Riot's text and I will not guess; I reworded around it and recorded it in questionsForUser. Content spikes[1] named his R 'Eulogy of the Damned'; corrected to Eulogy of the Isles.
